what: E003 steps 4-5, the first Part I attempt on the cloud VM, seed 1: stopped in the reading (reader-scope --part1 --elsewhere), before any plan

k1_check_on_vm.what: reader-scope --k 1 --elsewhere, 8 threads, nice 19, next to the part1 reading

first_start.bound: the sink thread: one core at 100%, the 32 workers idle

second_start.at_stop: pass 1, event round 3 (21093 runs from 22730 events)

why_stopped: Pass 1 was still in event round 3 after 26.5 min, with 7.95 M records at the end of round 2; the rounds did not shrink (19,847, 23,728, 21,093 runs).

The packed file grew about 2 GB a minute in round 2 (46.2 GB at the stop). vm_part1.sh's MAX_FILES_GB=100 and /dev/shm's 126 GB would have stopped pass 1, and the reader's last rewrite needs twice the file.

A second pass reads everything again (k=1 had two). taskcore's start check took 35 s on k=1's 316 MB file; at 46+ GB the check and the first plan alone would not have ended before the VM's 22:25 stop.
